title: GridSim v1 system.json
description: The case's system block: name, system base and nominal frequency. The file is optional; when it is absent every member takes its default. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

system.title: System
system.description: The case's system block (v1 SystemDto). Absent: name = the case folder name, baseMva 100, frequencyHz 50.

name.title: Case name
name.description: Display name of the case. Absent: the case folder's name.

baseMva.title: System base (MVA)
baseMva.description: The MVA base every per-unit impedance in the case is expressed on. Absent: 100 MVA (GridModel.DefaultBaseMva).

dispatch.title: Capacity-based dispatch
dispatch.description: false = keep the generator outputs exactly as written (no capacity-based balance); used by cases converted from MATPOWER (F24). Absent: true.
